task:
ClickHouse dialect: the parametric aggregate syntax of `groupConcat` fails to parse (reported from Superset):

```sql
SELECT groupConcat(', ')(part_name) AS concatenated FROM system.parts
```

raises `ParseError: Invalid expression`. Support `groupConcat`'s parametric form (separator as the parameter, column as the argument) so it parses and round-trips in ClickHouse.
why: The two patches make the same one-line fix: they add `"groupConcat"` to ClickHouse's `AGG_FUNCTIONS` and test the exact query from the report. Both stay in scope, follow the repo's existing pattern, and pass all checks. Coverage decided it. c1 also tests the combinator form, `groupConcatIf(', ')(part_name, x > 1)`. That form only works because names in this list automatically get combinator suffixes, so c1 checks that path too. c2 (the runner-up) is just as correct but only tests the base case.
